nibbhogo.g: Sabbapariyāyesu cettha vuttanayeneva yojanakkamaṁ viditvā sandhāya bhāsitamattaṁ1evaṁ veditabbaṁ–brāhmaṇo tameva vayovuḍḍhānaṁ abhivādanakammādiṁ loke sāmaggiparibhogoti maññamāno tadabhāvena Bhagavantaṁ nibbhogoti āha.

nibbhogobhavan.g: Sabbapariyāyesu cettha vuttanayeneva yojanākkamaṁ viditvā sandhāyabhāsitamatthaṁ2 evaṁ veditabbaṁ–brāhmaṇo tadeva vayovuddhānaṁ abhivādanādikammaṁ loke “sāmaggiparibhogo”ti maññamāno tadabhāvena ca Bhagavantaṁ “nibbhogo”ti-ādimāha.
